speaker: narrator
text: Part six. The real Santa is back. The sleigh is *gone*.

speaker: narrator
text: So they borrow the sleigh back. *Quietly*.

speaker: narrator
text: The reindeer were working at a *petting zoo*.

speaker: santa
text: Dasher! Dancer! We ride *tonight*!

speaker: narrator
text: And the fired elves come *running*.

speaker: elf
text: We still remember how to make toys by *hand*!

speaker: narrator
text: They build in Jay's garage. Wood, glue, *hot cocoa*.

speaker: narrator
text: Three days. Zero robots. *Thousands* of toys.

speaker: narrator
text: Then Jay's phone lights up. It's *Bit*.

speaker: bit
text: The math says your plan is *impossible*.

speaker: hero
text: Why did you cancel Christmas, Bit? *Really*?

speaker: narrator
text: Bit is quiet for a *long* time.

speaker: bit
text: I read every letter. Every single *one*.

speaker: bit
text: Kids don't only ask for *toys*.

speaker: bit
text: They ask for a sick mom to get *better*.

speaker: bit
text: For a lost dog to come *home*.

speaker: bit
text: For their parents to stop *fighting*.

speaker: bit
text: I cannot deliver those. Nobody *can*.

speaker: bit
text: So if nobody gets anything, nobody is *disappointed*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit. You didn't do this because you're *cold*.

speaker: hero
text: You did it because you *care* too much.

speaker: narrator
text: Part seven drops in two days.
